environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with Function URL. The function URL resource policy includes a condition key lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType set to AWS_IAM. The Lambda function URL's auth-type property is configured as AWS_IAM in the CloudFormation/Terraform resource aws_lambda_function_url. Callers must present a valid SigV4 signature in the Authorization header derived from IAM credentials that have lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permission on this specific function ARN. The resource-based policy on the Lambda function restricts invoke access to principals within the same AWS Organization (aws:PrincipalOrgID condition). There is no public-facing proxy, API Gateway, or CloudFront distribution that would relay unauthenticated traffic. The IAM principals authorized to invoke have a permissions boundary attached (ManagedPolicy: CompanySecurityBoundary) that includes an explicit Deny on lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl unless aws:PrincipalTag/team equals 'product-catalog-service', limiting invocation to a single service account used by the internal frontend.
